_comment: Inputs for experiments/analysis/cost_model.py. PRICES ARE DELIBERATELY null - look them up in the AWS Pricing Calculator (https://calculator.aws/) for your region and date, then fill them in. Do not copy prices from old blog posts.
pricing_source: AWS Price List API, ap-south-1 offer files: AWSLambda (published 2026-11-11), AmazonApiGateway (2026-11-12), AmazonCloudWatch (2026-11-04), AWSDataTransfer (2026-11-11). https://pricing.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/offers/v1.0/aws/<service>/current/ap-south-1/index.json
avg_billed_duration_source: Take from CloudWatch REPORT lines ('Billed Duration') of the AWS experiment; null = not yet measured
_price_notes: x86_64 Tier-1 compute price; HTTP API first 300M requests/month; CloudWatch Standard log class; data transfer first 10 TB after the 100 GB/month global free allowance. Free tier not applied.
avg_response_size_source: Measured 2026-11-16 on AWS: default request (top_n=5) = 1,919 B body + 234 B headers
log_bytes_per_request_source: Assumption (about 3 JSON lines + Lambda START/END/REPORT); replace with CloudWatch IncomingBytes / requests
